title: Publish to web
description: Anyone with the link can view this page and its subpages without signing in.
published: This page is published to the web
needsFullAccess: Only people with full access can publish.
notAllowed: This workspace lets only owners publish pages. Ask an owner to publish it.
archived: Pages in the trash can't be published.
confirmUnpublish: Unpublish this page? The link will stop working, and publishing again creates a new link.
notFoundBody: This link is invalid, or the page is no longer published.
name: Name
embedUnavailable: This database isn't published with this page.
indexableHint: Search engines may list this page and its subpages. Off by default: people then find it only through the link.
viewsHint: Visitors can switch between the views you pick, wherever this database is published.
outsideHint: This page shows these databases, but they don't lie under it. Pick the ones the published page shows anyway, without links to them or their rows, or move them under this page to publish them with it.
outsideHidden: {count, plural, one {The database you don't pick isn't shown: visitors see a note in its place.} other {The # databases you don't pick aren't shown: visitors see a note in their place.}}
inSiteHint: The site's navigation lists this page and its subpages.
allowDuplicateHint: Signed-in visitors can copy this page and its published subpages into a workspace of their own. Only what is published is copied.

duplicate.title: Duplicate “{title}”
duplicate.description: Copy this page and its published subpages into one of your workspaces. Only what the published page shows is copied: no comments, history or people.
duplicate.asTemplate: Add it to the workspace's templates
duplicate.asTemplateHint: New pages can then start from it.
duplicate.noWorkspaces: You don't have a workspace where you can add pages.
duplicate.notAllowed: The publisher doesn't allow duplicating this page.

errors.notAllowed: The publisher doesn't allow duplicating this page.
errors.noAccess: You can't add pages to that workspace.
errors.rateLimited: You've duplicated a lot of pages just now. Try again in a little while.
errors.tooLarge: This page has too many subpages or files to duplicate at once.
errors.tooDeep: This page's subpages are nested too deeply to duplicate.
errors.quotaExceeded: That workspace doesn't have room for this page's files.

publishingOff: Publishing to the web is turned off in this workspace. Published pages aren't shown until an owner turns it back on.
descriptionHint: Shown in search results and link previews. Empty: the site's default description.
expiryHint: The link works until you unpublish the page.
expiredOn: Expired on {date}: the link no longer works anywhere. Pick a later time or remove the expiry to bring it back.
expiryPast: Pick a time in the future.
expiryTooFar: Pick a time within the next ten years.
expiredDescription: Nobody can open this page or its subpages through the link now: visitors are told it wasn't found.
